description: Well how about that, you are in a place we're calling a kitchen. You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a fridge. I mean, just wow! Isn't TextWorld just the best? You can make out an oven. You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a table. The table is massive. On the table you see a cookbook. You see a counter. You see a chopped raw red potato and a raw purple potato on the counter. You can see a stove. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?
thought: First learn the recipe by examining the cookbook on the table; that will tell us what ingredients/tools we must gather and what cooking steps to do.
